headline: 哥斯拉领跑电影，再婚皇后首播
summary: 今日电影热度由《哥斯拉-0.0》《疾速追杀》等领跑；新剧《再婚皇后》首播，加入《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》等热播剧竞争，《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》等待映片持续预热。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《哥斯拉-0.0》《疾速追杀》等领跑本周热度。
industryHighlights.en: Movie highlights: Godzilla-0.0 and John Wick lead this week's buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《再婚皇后》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New series: The Remarried Empress premieres this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《梦魇绝镇》《小丑回魂：欢迎来到德里镇》等持续升温。
industryHighlights.en: Hot TV: Reacher, From and IT: Welcome to Derry remain in the spotlight.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《饥饿游戏：收获日出》等蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Avengers 5, Dune 3 and The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping build anticipation.

headlineEn: Godzilla Leads Movies, The Remarried Empress Premieres
summaryEn: Movie buzz is led by Godzilla-0.0 and John Wick, while new series The Remarried Empress premieres and joins hot shows like Reacher and From; upcoming films such as Avengers 5 and Dune 3 keep building anticipation.
